summary: Join our comprehensive training course on Baseline Studies and Needs Assessments for NGOs. Equip yourself with vital tools for impactful project planning.
lede: Baseline studies and needs assessments for NGOs help you define problems clearly, understand who is affected and why, and turn community realities into focused program priorities. They provide credible starting-point evidence for indicators, monitoring, evaluation, and demonstrating change over time. This practical course shows you how to frame objectives, choose rapid, full, or mixed assessment methods, and develop questionnaires, KIIs, FGDs, and observation checklists. You will also learn to protect data quality and ethics, analyze findings to prioritize needs, and communicate results in donor-ready formats.
audienceIntro: This course is crafted for NGO professionals and partners who are pivotal in program design and execution.
modules: Foundations of Baseline Studies and Needs Assessments
Defining the Problem and Assessment Objectives
Sampling and Targeting for Field Assessments
Data Quality Assurance and Field Management
Ethics, Safeguarding, and Do-No-Harm in Assessments
From Findings to Program Design and Prioritization
Common Pitfalls, Bias, and Improving Credibility
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of project management and monitoring and evaluation concepts.
